config.purpose: Gate 2 v2 repair: multi-filler robustness test. Same 8-arm design with 3 independently selected filler pairs. Tests whether the residual order contrast (the CORRECT statistic) is consistent across filler pairs. If consistent: genuine surface interaction. If filler-dependent: filler-specific artifact.

pre_registered_statistic.name: residual_order_contrast
pre_registered_statistic.gate: median residual_order_contrast > eps_eq across 24 contexts, consistent across 3 filler pairs
pre_registered_statistic.consistency_test: max pairwise TV between filler-pair-specific residuals < 2 * median residual

config.estimated_calls: AM/MA shared across pairs (48) + 6 filler arms x 3 pairs x 24 contexts (432) = 480 calls, ~12-15 min CPU
